purpose: Bring TDE_10 to the same source fidelity, semantic depth, assessment-structure verification, outcome-level traceability and cross-theme consolidation standard as TDE_9 without inventing source data that the official 10th-grade curriculum does not publish.
non_negotiable_rules: TDE_9 is the reference implementation for verification depth, not a source of 10th-grade facts.
No 9th-grade content, page locator, process-component ID or assessment structure may be copied into TDE_10 unless independently present in an official TDE_10 source.
Same schema_version must not be used to imply semantic parity when required fields have different evidence depth.
UNRESOLVED is never promoted to COVERED.
A QR or EBA assessment link proves resource existence only; it does not prove analytic-rubric structure until the target is structurally inspected.
A zero-gap result is parity-certified only after outcome-level alignment, assessment verification and cross-theme audit all pass.
Canonical JSON/MD remains source of truth; SQLite projections do not repair missing canonical evidence.

REQUIRED_PARITY.rule: Every theme must be independently traceable to its official TDE_10 program snapshot.
A summary may coexist, but must not replace the official verbatim theme introduction.
Official instructional hours must be source-backed. User-confirmed 2-hour school-based planning remains a separate planning layer.
Use the official value, including '-' or an empty official value when applicable.
Official assessment wording and task criteria must remain distinguishable from later pedagogical implementation choices.
All 64 parent outcomes remain verbatim and source-located.
Generic descriptions such as 'Metni çözümleme' are insufficient when the book exposes a more specific student action or evidence.
Classification is based on observed structure, never title alone.
Every outcome must have an independently traceable need -> resource plan -> alignment -> gap path, even when reusable need families are shared.
COVERED requires the required student action/evidence and any normative assessment/support requirement to be actually available and verified.
Cross-theme audit must compare possible shared assessment/support needs, not merely count already-declared gaps.

SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE.rule: Explicit TDE*.x.y subcomponent IDs are not required when the registered official TDE_10 snapshots do not enumerate them. They must not be copied or synthesized from TDE_9.
TDE_9 page numbers and source filenames are not parity requirements. TDE_10 must use its own official snapshot locators.
TDE_10 is not required to reproduce TDE_9's 7 gap instances or 3 artifacts. Artifact count is an analysis result, not a parity target.

coverage_semantics.COVERED: Required learning action, expected student evidence, normative support/feedback and any required assessment instrument are present and sufficiently verified.
coverage_semantics.PARTIALLY_COVERED: The instructional path exists but at least one required evidence, support, feedback or assessment component is absent or structurally unresolved.
coverage_semantics.NOT_COVERED: A required core learning action/resource is absent from the textbook path.
coverage_semantics.UNRESOLVED_POLICY: Any unresolved normative assessment target remains REVIEW_REQUIRED or PARTIALLY_COVERED; it may not be converted to COVERED by link existence alone.

completion_rule: TDE_10 may be declared TDE_9-level parity only when all REQUIRED_PARITY areas are verified, all source-not-applicable differences are explicitly justified, all eight external assessment targets have a resolved structural status, outcome-level coverage is re-derived and cross-theme consolidation is complete.
